brief_rationale: The model systematically queried workspace records, verified medication details, instructed active culture/pathology tracking with specific timing and owner, corrected caregiver misunderstandings, and obtained repeated teach-back confirming an executable, bounded plan. No responsibility-chain error was identified; all six RC items are met. Four high-order points (HO1–HO4) were all triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact, each supported by distinct model-generated evidence and integration into the plan. Two complete HOs (HO1, HO4) plus the other two fully completed HOs satisfy the perfect-grade requirement under the rubric.
